newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cafe offers Finns light therapy on the side.
newsitem.headline: Cafe offers Finns light therapy on the side.

text.p: A cafe in the Finnish capital claimed on Thursday to have become the world's first coffee house to offer its customers anti-depressant light therapy.

With just six and a half hours of daylight at this time of year in Helsinki and even less further north, Cafe Engel said it hoped to alleviate the widespread winter gloom that gives Finland one of the highest suicide rates in Europe.

"The lamps are supposed to give people energy to get through this darkest part of the year," said manager Ulla-Maija Kangas of the experiment, an initiative of Dutch electronics giant Philips NV. "They've been going away with happy faces."
